_about: Series-knowledge stat estimates [str, spd, abl, iq, dur, reason] for characters without a usable VS Battles page (from the 2026-11-16 placeholder fill). Used by npm run wiki:db-derive only when the character still has placeholder 50s. IQ here is ignored; IQ comes from manual-iq-overrides.json.

gabi-aot: Child Warrior candidate and sharpshooter; no titan powers.
